indices.createSql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_transcript_segments_displayName` ON `${TABLE_NAME}` (`displayName`)

entities.createSql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` USING FTS4(`text` TEXT NOT NULL, tokenize=unicode61, content=`transcript_segments`)
contentSyncTriggers: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_transcript_segments_fts_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON `transcript_segments` BEGIN DELETE FROM `transcript_segments_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_transcript_segments_fts_BEFORE_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON `transcript_segments` BEGIN DELETE FROM `transcript_segments_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_transcript_segments_fts_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON `transcript_segments` BEGIN INSERT INTO `transcript_segments_fts`(`docid`, `text`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`text`); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_transcript_segments_fts_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON `transcript_segments` BEGIN INSERT INTO `transcript_segments_fts`(`docid`, `text`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`text`); END
